pages.summary: Jane y Malcolm cuentan cómo recibieron la carta de Hogwarts. Pansy comprende qué les costó dejar partir a Hermione.

panels.scene: At the same oak dinner table, Jane calmly recalls the day the letter arrived. Her gray-streaked brown waves, ivory collar, sage sweater and warm older face match the reference exactly. Malcolm and Hermione listen, and Pansy looks over from her chair.
dialogue: Jane: Cuando llegó tu carta de Hogwarts, pensamos que era una broma.

panels.scene: Visual insert, just a parchment envelope with deep green address strokes and burgundy wax seal on a small oak side table, two soft pools of lamplight. No people in this still life, no readable extra letters.
panels.caption: La carta venía con tinta verde y sello de cera.

panels.scene: Storybook memory insert in the same oak sitting room: small healthy pink pig on the patterned rug where a low coffee table usually stands. One tiny harmless sparkle above the rug, hearth and bay window. No people in the picture. Jane narrates from off-panel.
dialogue: Jane, fuera de cuadro: Después McGonagall convirtió la mesa de centro en un cerdo.

panels.scene: Return to the same dinner. Malcolm in a navy V-neck and pale blue shirt looks over his rectangular glasses toward Hermione. His expression is protective and thoughtful. Two natural hands resting by his place setting.
dialogue: Malcolm: Nos costó confiarte a un mundo al que no podíamos seguirte.

panels.scene: Pansy at her seat in dark evergreen sweater, fingers resting on the table. She glances down toward a single small, fully clothed Robin sleeping comfortably in his own cream Zephyr pram, a quiet family moment.
dialogue: Pansy: No sé si yo podría hacerlo.

panels.scene: Jane turns kindly toward Pansy. Both remain seated at the same dining table. Soft brass light and a few plates. Keep the mature Granger adult face and the two students' faces distinct.
dialogue: Jane: Tendrías miedo. Y lo harías si fuera lo mejor para él.

pages.summary: Los Granger recuerdan la primera noticia sobre Robin. Malcolm y Pansy quedan para ver el motor antes de que Jane pregunte cómo se conocieron.

panels.scene: Malcolm pushes his glasses up by the bridge, smiling with recollection across the round table. Hermione looks slightly embarrassed.
dialogue: Malcolm: Llegaste a decirnos que tenías un bebé y que Pansy era su otra madre.

panels.scene: Jane's warm smile toward Hermione and then Pansy, Robin's pram near edge of frame. Pansy raises an interested eyebrow.
dialogue: Jane: Después nos hablaste de Robin durante cuarenta minutos.

panels.scene: At floor level, the sand-and-brass Zephyr hovers gently over the oak floor with its hood half raised, a natural illustration of fictional magic. Malcolm studies the frame at a distance, Pansy in green looks amused. Set the camera angle so Malcolm is on the LEFT and speaks first, Pansy on the RIGHT and speaks second, without changing who sits where. The left balloon appears first, right balloon follows, both clear above faces.
dialogue: Malcolm: Todavía quiero saber cómo flota sin motor.
Pansy: Encantamientos de levitación.

panels.scene: Malcolm leans back smiling, no tools in hand. Pansy playfully lifts her chin, and Hermione hides a smile behind her glass of water. Set the camera angle so Malcolm is on the LEFT and speaks first, Pansy on the RIGHT and speaks second, without changing who sits where. The left balloon appears first, right balloon follows, both clear above faces.
dialogue: Malcolm: Mañana te enseño un motor de verdad. A las nueve.
Pansy: A las ocho.

panels.scene: A quick warm cut as Malcolm nods, holding one hand relaxed at the edge of the table. Pansy smiles. Jane sets a folded napkin aside.
dialogue: Malcolm: A las ocho.

panels.scene: Jane folds her hands and looks curiously from Pansy to Hermione. Both students look toward Jane. The two faces stay distinct.
dialogue: Jane: Y cuéntenme, ¿cómo se conocieron?

pages.summary: Hermione recuerda el primer encuentro, cuando ambas esperaban la selección en el Gran Comedor.

panels.scene: Present. Hermione begins the story, hands relaxed near her plate. Pansy looks up at her as if trying to place the memory. The pram is still beside the table.
dialogue: Hermione: Nos conocimos antes de que nos asignaran una casa.

panels.scene: Memory. Large oak doors to the Great Hall, long row of fully clothed first-years in black robes, candles floating under a starry vaulted sky. Young Hermione and young Pansy stand beside each other near foreground. Distinct child faces.
panels.caption: Fue su primer día en Hogwarts.

panels.scene: Memory. Young Hermione looks up with curiosity and speaks excitedly, pointing with one hand toward the star-like enchanted ceiling. Young Pansy turns toward her.
dialogue: Hermione niña: El techo está encantado. Lo leí en Historia de Hogwarts.

panels.scene: Memory. Young Pansy gives a very direct green-eyed look, small frown, and clasps her own hands at waist. Young Hermione looks taken aback but attentive.
dialogue: Pansy niña: Cualquiera con ojos puede ver que está encantado.

panels.scene: Back in present. Hermione, now older with hair in a loose bun, looks across at Pansy and remembers, a calm smile. Jane and Malcolm listen.
dialogue: Hermione: Nunca había visto unos ojos de un verde tan intenso.

panels.scene: Present, tight on Pansy with green eyes and simple evergreen crewneck. She looks down at her place setting, thoughtful. Hermione sees the change in her expression.
dialogue: Pansy: Eso no es todo.

pages.review: La cena se alterna con el Gran Comedor. Los recuerdos muestran a las dos alumnas antes de la selección, sin insignias de casa. Se preservan los rasgos de ambas y el texto.

Pansy older student sleek short black bob and narrow green eyes, angular jaw and bare ears, evergreen crewneck and charcoal trousers. Keep seats, character faces and objects across the dinner. Alternating present dinner and school memories. Thin black rectangular panel outlines, narrow cream gutters, large readable speech balloons and captions with clear tails. Read left to right, top to bottom. Print only the exact text in quotation marks in the panel list and the header, with all Spanish accents. Speaker names specify balloon tails and are not printed. No added words, footer or watermark.
Within a panel, the balloons follow the stated dialogue order. Stage the first speaker to the left and the reply to the right when compatible with the shot. Otherwise clearly stagger the reply below the first balloon. Distinct tails and negative space above the faces, without hiding eyes or hair.
Panel 1. Present. Hermione begins the story, hands relaxed near her plate. Pansy looks up at her as if trying to place the memory. The pram is still beside the table. Balloon from Hermione. Print verbatim «Nos conocimos antes de que nos asignaran una casa.»
Panel 2. Memory. Large oak doors to the Great Hall, long row of fully clothed first-years in black robes, candles floating under a starry vaulted sky. Young Hermione and young Pansy stand beside each other near foreground. Distinct child faces. Caption verbatim «Fue su primer día en Hogwarts.»
Panel 3. Memory. Young Hermione looks up with curiosity and speaks excitedly, pointing with one hand toward the star-like enchanted ceiling. Young Pansy turns toward her. Balloon from Hermione niña. Print verbatim «El techo está encantado. Lo leí en Historia de Hogwarts.»
Panel 4. Memory. Young Pansy gives a very direct green-eyed look, small frown, and clasps her own hands at waist. Young Hermione looks taken aback but attentive. Balloon from Pansy niña. Print verbatim «Cualquiera con ojos puede ver que está encantado.»
Panel 5. Back in present. Hermione, now older with hair in a loose bun, looks across at Pansy and remembers, a calm smile. Jane and Malcolm listen. Balloon from Hermione. Print verbatim «Nunca había visto unos ojos de un verde tan intenso.»
Panel 6. Present, tight on Pansy with green eyes and simple evergreen crewneck. She looks down at her place setting, thoughtful. Hermione sees the change in her expression. Balloon from Pansy. Print verbatim «Eso no es todo.»

pages.summary: Pansy reconoce su crueldad de entonces. Hermione y sus padres escuchan cómo cambió su relación.

panels.scene: At the warm table Pansy places a glass on the wood. Her shoulders are straight and she looks at both Granger parents. Hermione listens. Robin sleeps in the same pram.
dialogue: Pansy: Durante años la traté como si no tuviera derecho a pertenecer a nuestro mundo. Fui cruel.

panels.scene: Malcolm's face is serious behind his rectangular glasses. He takes a quiet breath. Jane listens with no smile, both seated and still.
dialogue: Malcolm: Me cuesta imaginar que trataran así a nuestra hija. Pero Hermione confía en ti.

panels.scene: Hermione looks at her parents without looking away. Pansy glances at her in surprise. Hands at table, no overlap.
dialogue: Hermione: Pansy me pidió perdón hace tiempo. Cambió por su cuenta.

panels.scene: Jane nods warmly across the table. Pansy lets her fingertips rest on the wood beside Hermione’s hand, with exactly two natural hands visible if shown.
dialogue: Jane: Gracias por contárnoslo.

panels.scene: One quiet insert of Robin asleep in the pram under the cream hood, then Hermione in profile beside it looking at Pansy. Pansy turns toward her.
dialogue: Hermione: El proyecto nos enseñó a cuidarnos. Pansy se queda incluso cuando tiene miedo.

panels.scene: Low warm close of Pansy looking at Hermione, her hands resting on the table. Hermione's brown eyes move toward her. One lamp glow, no baby in this close framing.
dialogue: Pansy: Cuando los miro a los dos, sé dónde quiero estar.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 12 · 24

Pansy reconoce su crueldad de entonces. Hermione y sus padres escuchan cómo cambió su relación.
Pansy: Durante años la traté como si no tuviera derecho a pertenecer a nuestro mundo. Fui cruel.
Malcolm: Me cuesta imaginar que trataran así a nuestra hija. Pero Hermione confía en ti.
Hermione: Pansy me pidió perdón hace tiempo. Cambió por su cuenta.
Jane: Gracias por contárnoslo.
Hermione: El proyecto nos enseñó a cuidarnos. Pansy se queda incluso cuando tiene miedo.
Pansy: Cuando los miro a los dos, sé dónde quiero estar.
pages.review: Se revisó la conversación completa. La expresión y ubicación de cada persona siguen la cena anterior. Robin duerme en el Zephyr y las seis réplicas se conservan.
